column1: # Rows of the ECS TypeId table read off the Linux disassembly by hand (tools/disasm.py), keyed by ELF
# each must be in typeids/<build>.tsv verbatim, and for id rows the registrant function verify finds
# must be `registrant`. `witness` says what was seen, so that it can be seen again on the next build.
# The registrant's shape (c8da62b1): a static node {+0 &m_TypeIndex, +8 name ptr, +0x10 name len,
# +0x18 next} under a __cxa_guard; the name comes from the __PRETTY_FUNCTION__ string
# "ls::StringView ls::GetTypeName() [T = X]" through 0x28ddf70, built in the registrant itself
# (systems, static data, some components) or in a name getter it calls; then the node is pushed onto
